g1.label: 1. Mumbai is the ___ city
g1.why: The text says Mumbai is the largest city in India.

g2.label: 2. Often called the ___ capital
g2.why: The text says Mumbai is often called the financial capital of India.

g3.label: 3. Skyscrapers next to enormous ___
g3.why: The text says expensive skyscrapers are built next to enormous slums.

g4.label: 4. Products made in small ___
g4.why: The text says many products are made in small workshops.

g5.label: 5. Workers are paid very ___
g5.why: The text says the workers are often paid very little for long hours.

g6.label: 6. ___ organisations help protect workers
g6.why: The text says fair-trade organisations help to protect workers.

g7.label: 7. A fair-trade label means a fair ___
g7.why: The text says a fair-trade label means workers were paid a fair wage.

g8.label: 8. Some brands have been ___
g8.why: The text says some brands have been criticised for poor conditions.

g1.label: 1. Many products ___ in workshops
g1.why: ‘Products’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are made’, not ‘is made’.

g2.label: 2. Mumbai ___ the financial capital
g2.why: ‘Mumbai’ is singular, so the passive uses ‘is called’.

g3.label: 3. Skyscrapers ___ next to slums
g3.why: ‘Skyscrapers’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are built’.

g4.label: 4. The workers ___ very little
g4.why: ‘The workers’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are paid’.

g5.label: 5. Clothes and jewellery ___ around the world
g5.why: Two subjects joined by ‘and’ take a plural passive: ‘are sold’.

g6.label: 6. A fair wage ___ to workers
g6.why: ‘A fair wage’ is singular, so the passive uses ‘is given’.

g7.label: 7. Poor factories ___ in the news
g7.why: ‘Factories’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are criticised’.

g8.label: 8. Workers ___ with respect
g8.why: ‘Workers’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are treated’.

g1.label: 1. Last year, a new law ___
g1.why: ‘Last year’ is a specific past time, so the simple past passive ‘was passed’ is used.

g2.label: 2. Today, many clothes ___ in India
g2.why: ‘Today’ signals a general present fact, so the present passive ‘are made’ is used.

g3.label: 3. In 2013, one factory ___
g3.why: ‘In 2013’ is a specific past time, so the simple past passive ‘was closed’ is used.

g4.label: 4. These days, fair-trade labels ___
g4.why: ‘These days’ signals the present, so the present passive ‘are seen’ is used.

g5.label: 5. Yesterday, the report ___
g5.why: ‘Yesterday’ is a specific past time, so the simple past passive ‘was presented’ is used.

g6.label: 6. Every day, thousands of items ___
g6.why: ‘Every day’ signals a habitual present fact, so the present passive ‘are produced’ is used.

g7.label: 7. Recently, one brand ___
g7.why: A finished, recent event is described with the simple past passive ‘was criticised’.

g8.label: 8. These days, workers' rights ___ seriously
g8.why: ‘These days’ signals the present, so the present passive ‘are taken’ is used.
